Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_DM_02097] Provision of request handle
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04170
⌈
The DM shall provide the request handle of the diagnostic request within metaInfo
using the Key kRequestHandle in all the subsequently called ara::diag interfaces.
⌋
[SWS_DM_02098] Provision of local
IP
address
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04170
⌈
The DM shall provide the local IP address within metaInfo using the Key kLocalIP in
all the subsequently called ara::diag interfaces.
⌋
[SWS_DM_02099] Provision of local port number
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04170
⌈
The DM shall provide the local port number within metaInfo using the Key kLocalPort
in all the subsequently called ara::diag interfaces.
⌋
[SWS_DM_02102] Provision of remote
IP
address
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04170
⌈
The DM shall provide the remote IP address within metaInfo using the Key kRemoteIP
in all the subsequently called ara::diag interfaces.
⌋
[SWS_DM_02103] Provision of remote port number
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04170
⌈
The DM shall provide the remote port number within metaInfo using the Key kRe-
motePort in all the subsequently called ara::diag interfaces.
⌋
[SWS_DM_02104] Provision of DTC number
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04170
⌈
The DM shall provide the DTC number for which the interfaces is triggered within
metaInfo using the Key kDtc in all the subsequently called ara::diag interfaces for the
purpose of extended data and snapshot data collection.
⌋
[SWS_DM_02105] Provision of kDoIP context
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04170
⌈
The DM shall use the context for metaInfo as kDoIP if a DataIdentifier is read accord-
ing to [SWS_DM_00855].
⌋
